title: Aubergine, broccoli and red lentil dal

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain cupboard staple: lentils, tinned tomatoes, spices, oil and fresh vegetables.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only one large pan and a wooden spoon, and the technique is simple frying and simmering.

works.reason: 250g red lentils with 900ml water and a tin of tomatoes simmered for 20 minutes gives a sensible dal consistency, and with two aubergines and a head of broccoli it makes a good amount for four.

honest_times.reason: 25 minutes of prep covers chopping five vegetables plus about 11 minutes of frying, and 25 minutes of cook covers the 20-minute simmer.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Aubergine is the bulk of the dish alongside July broccoli, and a light spiced dal suits a summer evening.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling, vegetable- and pulse-rich dinner a family would happily eat again.
